themes.description: This theme covers user complaints related to financial losses, perceived unfairness, or the 'gambling' nature of investments on the platform, and the overall outcome of their trading/investment activities.
This theme covers user complaints or feedback related to the availability, access, or success rates of specific investment opportunities like IPO allotments.
This theme covers requests for new features, improvements to existing features, or complaints about missing functionality within the application.
Issues related to data privacy, unauthorized access, account security, and protection of personal information.
Problems related to misleading interface design, deceptive patterns, poor usability, and overall user experience.
Problems related to the allocation, delivery, or management of specific investment products like IPOs, mutual funds, or bonds.
Covers issues related to the application's user interface, design, ease of use, and overall user experience.
Covers concerns about misleading information, lack of transparency, perceived fraudulent activities, or issues impacting user trust.
This theme covers requests for new features or complaints about the absence of expected functionalities within the application.
Concerns or limitations related to specific trading functionalities, order types, charting tools, or trade management within the app.
This theme covers issues related to account opening, KYC processes, document submission, and general account information updates.
Suggestions for new features, enhancements, or improvements to the application's functionality.
Concerns related to the application's ease of use, user interface design, and overall user experience.
Covers issues related to the ease of use, intuitiveness, or design of specific application features.
Covers feedback on the app's ease of use, intuitiveness, design, and overall user experience.

This theme covers feedback and complaints related to the terms, conditions, or nature of specific financial products, services, or policies offered. It includes concerns about product features or limitations.
This theme covers general positive or negative comments about the app's overall experience, usability, or satisfaction, without focusing on specific issues.
This theme covers reviews that compare the app's features, performance, or market position against competitors.
This theme addresses complaints or suggestions related to the app's layout, design, button placement, and overall user experience.
Requests for learning resources, trading guidance, financial education, or general help on how to use the platform for investment.
Problems related to account creation, personal detail inaccuracies, KYC, or account access.
Concerns regarding changes in financial policies, risk management, margin requirements, or terms of service related to trading and investments.

This theme covers serious allegations of fraud, scamming, manipulated data, and untrustworthy practices by the platform. It addresses concerns about the fundamental honesty and reliability of the service.
